cache_db_file.description: Path to the SQLite cache database file. See FILES section in man page.

smtp_host.description: Hostname of the SMTP server for email notifications.

smtp_port.description: Port number of the SMTP server.

smtp_password.description: Password for SMTP authentication. Man page suggests storing in keyring.

smtp_sender.description: The email address used in the From: header.

smtp_recipients.description: List of email addresses to send notifications to.
